method.paired_bootstrap: resampling of test rows with replacement, 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng seed 20261015; the same resample indices are shared by every comparison on a split; 95% percentile interval; two-sided p = 2 min(P(delta <= 0), P(delta >= 0)); delta = b minus a
method.mcnemar: exact two-sided McNemar test on the rows where exactly one of the two models is correct
method.holm: Holm step-down correction inside each preregistered family
method.success_rule: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and lower interval bound > 0
method.seed_mean: H2 compares the mean test Macro-F1 of the three SD seeds with that of the three A seeds, recomputed inside every resample

cross_dataset.description: Preregistered replication on three further datasets. H1: SD uniform-6 soup vs A_s42; H2: SD seed mean vs A seed mean; test Macro-F1 over all classes of the dataset. One Holm family over the six tests.

reported_reference_macro_f1.note: other systems report their own numbers; trained on the virus training split as here

usual.description: Usual domain (SMP2020-EWECT general Weibo). H1 and H2 recomputed for the package from reference/predictions with the same procedure as the cross-dataset family; the usual domain was the development domain of the method, so these two tests are not part of that family.

preregistered_sd_seed_confirmation.description: Preregistered test on the usual domain before the soup existed: SD vs A per seed (McNemar) and SD seed mean vs A seed mean (paired bootstrap).

usual_ablations.description: Usual-domain ablations (preregistered before any ablation model was trained or scored). Family S (soups, m = 4): S1 soup_sd3 vs a_soup, S2 soup_sd5 vs soup_a5, S3 soup vs soup_sd3, S4 soup vs naive_soup. Family T (teachers, m = 3, mean of the two half models): T1 SD half models vs insample_teacher, T2 vs label_smoothing, T3 vs permuted_teacher. delta = b minus a.

virus_ensemble_selection.description: Virus domain, preregistered: greedy forward ensemble selection with replacement (Caruana et al., 2004; 25 steps, chosen on virus dev Macro-F1) over the 13 virus models, compared with the SD uniform-6 soup on test (own family, m = 1).

wrime_edom18.description: WRIME test split relabelled with the edom18 rule (descriptive, not in any family); see reference/wrime_edom18_protocol.json.
